name: Ingyaku Joshi Kangoku
source:
2020 AD. Population has bursted increasing crime level. Prisons are functioning at 180% capacity. Government issues Article 59 called "Prison Private Property Law", according to which prison personnel can take prisoners home to take care of them. Main character is a part of this experiment giving shelter to five women prisoners.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2020年。人口激增，犯罪率上升。
监狱以180%容量运作。
政府出台名为“监狱私有财产法”的第59条，据此监狱工作人员可以把囚犯带回家照管。
主人公参与这一实验，为5名女囚提供住处。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
